info.title: CurrencyMesh API
info.description:
Sandbox API for cross-border stablecoin payments across cNGN, cGHS, cXAF, USDx and EURx.

Amounts are decimal strings, e.g. "100.50". Requests that move money need an `Idempotency-Key` header.

post.description: Needs an email, a phone in international format, or both. Each email and phone can own only one wallet. Starts with a zero balance in every currency.

Location.description: Where the new wallet can be fetched

error.message: currency must be one of: cNGN, cGHS, cXAF, USDx, EURx

details.message: currency must be one of: cNGN, cGHS, cXAF, USDx, EURx

error.message: A wallet with this email already exists

get.summary: Get a wallet with its balances and total in USD
get.description: The summary view: who owns the wallet, what it holds, and the total in USD. For the USD value of each balance and the rates used, see /balances.

get.summary: Get the USD breakdown of every balance
get.description: The breakdown view: each balance valued in USDx at the current rate, the total, and which rates were used (source and refresh time). All lines use one rate snapshot, and totalUsd is the sum of the lines.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique per request (a UUID is recommended). Retrying with the same key and body replays the first response; the money moves once.

Location.description: Where the new transaction can be fetched

Idempotent-Replayed.description: true when this response was replayed from an earlier request with the same key

post.summary: Swap one stablecoin for another in the same wallet
post.description: Converts at the current FX rate. The received amount is rounded down to 6 decimal places, so a swap never creates money.
